'''2006 Minnesota State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Minnesota in July 2006. The championship was scheduled for 29 July at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights, following constructed and sealed-deck side events on 28 July.<ref name="mn2006-announcement">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9699&amp;view=next 2006 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend], [[Nick Kolnik]], Players Committee Forums. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095554/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9699&amp;view=next Internet Archive] (18 June 2006).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Columbia Heights, Minnesota<ref name="mn2006-announcement" />
* '''Dates:''' 29 July 2006 (scheduled)<ref name="mn2006-announcement" />
* '''Venue:''' Twin City Comics<ref name="mn2006-announcement" />

== Schedule and prizes ==

The announced state championship schedule comprised six games and a final confrontation between the top two players. Guaranteed cash prizes were offered for the top three, and the winner was offered a virtual-card design opportunity and a World Championship Day 2 bye.<ref name="mn2006-announcement" />

The 28 July side events comprised a four-game constructed tournament and a four-game [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck|OTSD]] draft. Each winner was offered a virtual-card design opportunity.<ref name="mn2006-announcement" />
